import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
h,w,_ = im.shape
print(\"shape\", im.shape)
# Find saturated block pixels
r,g,b = im[...,0].astype(int), im[...,1].astype(int), im[...,2].astype(int)
mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn = np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
sat = mx-mn
mask = (sat>60) & (mx>80)
ys,xs = np.where(mask)
print(\"sat bbox x\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y\", ys.min(), ys.max(), \"count\", mask.sum())
# column profile of mask to find blocks
cols = mask.sum(axis=0)
runs=[]
inrun=False
for x in range(w):
    if cols[x]>0 and not inrun:
        s=x; inrun=True
    elif cols[x]==0 and inrun:
        runs.append((s,x-1)); inrun=False
if inrun: runs.append((s,w-1))
print(\"x runs:\", runs)
for (s,e) in runs:
    sub = mask[:, s:e+1]
    yy,xx = np.where(sub)
    # dominant color
    px = im[sub]
    med = np.median(px,axis=0).astype(int)
    print(f\"block x[{s},{e}] w={e-s+1} y[{yy.min()},{yy.max()}] h={yy.max()-yy.min()+1} median RGB={med}\")
EOF"
